Here is a detailed description of the illustrative figure, based on your methodology section and figure caption:

**Figure Description: Stage 3 — Multi-Model Barrier Rating**

**Overall Layout:**
The diagram will have a pure white background and an aspect ratio of 4:3 (1100 logical units wide by 825 logical units high). The overall flow is strictly top-to-bottom, structured into three distinct tiers. The central Tier 2 clearly emphasizes three parallel, independent processing paths. All text will use a clean serif font similar to Georgia or Palatino. There will be no drop shadows, gradients, 3D effects, or decorative icons; the design will be flat and clean.

**Tier 1: Input (Top Center)**
*   **Component:** A single rounded rectangle, centrally placed at the top of the diagram.
    *   **Dimensions:** Approximately 400 units wide by 50 units high.
    *   **Fill:** Pure white.
    *   **Border:** A 2-pixel solid line in a distinct Navy blue (#205493).
    *   **Main Label:** Centered within the box, "1,598 question pairs (1,030 CPS–ACS + 568 FoodAPS–ACS)".
        *   **Font:** 10px serif font, dark charcoal text color (#333333).
    *   **Sublabel:** Centered below the main label, "Each pair: source question text + ACS question text + shared subtopic".
        *   **Font:** 9px serif italic font, muted blue-grey text color (#4B636E).

**Downward Arrow Split:**
*   A single, vertical, 2-pixel solid Navy blue (#205493) arrow originates from the bottom center of the Tier 1 input box.
*   This arrow descends a short distance and then splits into three equally spaced, parallel vertical arrows. Each of these three arrows is also a 2-pixel solid Navy blue (#205493) line, indicating independent data flow to the three rater modules below.

**Tier 2: Three Independent Raters (Middle Section)**
This tier consists of three identical, vertically oriented rounded rectangles arranged horizontally, representing the independent raters. They are equally spaced across the width of the diagram below the split arrows.

*   **Rater 1: OpenAI (Left Column)**
    *   **Component:** A rounded rectangle.
        *   **Dimensions:** Approximately 260 units wide by 250 units high.
        *   **Fill:** A soft Light blue (#DCEEFB).
        *   **Border:** A 2-pixel solid line in Navy blue (#205493).
    *   **Header Bar:** A solid Navy blue (#205493) rectangle, 30 units high, fixed at the top internal edge of the rater box.
        *   **Text:** Centered within the header bar, "Rater 1: OpenAI".
        *   **Font:** 11px serif bold font, pure white text.
    *   **Body Content (inside the light blue box, below the header):** All text is left-aligned.
        *   "Model: gpt-5-mini" (8px serif italic, muted blue-grey #4B636E).
        *   (One blank line space)
        *   "For each pair, assign:" (9px serif, dark charcoal #333333).
        *   (One blank line space)
        *   **Small Inner Box 1 (Feasibility):** A small, pure white filled rectangle with a 1-pixel solid Navy blue (#205493) border.
            *   **Label:** "Feasibility" (9px serif bold, dark charcoal #333333).
            *   **Content:**
                *   "F1 = direct recode" (8px serif, dark charcoal #333333).
                *   "F2 = statistical adjustment" (8px serif, dark charcoal #333333).
                *   "F3 = incompatible" (8px serif, dark charcoal #333333).
        *   (One blank line space)
        *   **Small Inner Box 2 (Barrier code):** A small, pure white filled rectangle with a 1-pixel solid Navy blue (#205493) border.
            *   **Label:** "Barrier code (if F3)" (9px serif bold, dark charcoal #333333).
            *   **Content:** "CC TC RS PC MC PM" (8px serif, dark charcoal #333333).
        *   (One blank line space)
        *   **Small Inner Box 3 (Reasoning):** A small, pure white filled rectangle with a 1-pixel solid Navy blue (#205493) border.
            *   **Label:** "Reasoning" (9px serif bold, dark charcoal #333333).
            *   **Content:** "Free-text justification" (8px serif italic, muted blue-grey #4B636E).

*   **Rater 2: Anthropic (Center Column)**
    *   Identical structure, dimensions, fills, and borders as Rater 1.
    *   **Header Bar Text:** "Rater 2: Anthropic" (11px serif bold, pure white).
    *   **Body Content:**
        *   "Model: claude-haiku-4-5" (8px serif italic, muted blue-grey #4B636E).
        *   All other internal labels and content are identical to Rater 1.

*   **Rater 3: Google (Right Column)**
    *   Identical structure, dimensions, fills, and borders as Rater 1.
    *   **Header Bar Text:** "Rater 3: Google" (11px serif bold, pure white).
    *   **Body Content:**
        *   "Model: gemini-3-flash" (8px serif italic, muted blue-grey #4B636E).
        *   All other internal labels and content are identical to Rater 1.

*   **Separators and Grouping:**
    *   Between each rater column (i.e., between Rater 1 & 2, and Rater 2 & 3), a vertical 1-pixel dashed line in a medium Grey (#B0BEC5) extends downwards from just below the split arrows to above the converging arrows.
    *   Small 'X' symbols (using a simple 'X' character in muted blue-grey #4B636E, 8px serif) will be placed along these dashed lines, indicating a barrier.
    *   Below these dashed lines, centered horizontally across all three rater columns, is an annotation: "No communication between raters".
        *   **Font:** 8px serif italic, muted blue-grey text color (#4B636E).

**Three Downward Arrows Converging:**
*   From the bottom center of each of the three rater boxes, a 2-pixel solid Navy blue (#205493) vertical arrow descends.
*   These three arrows converge into a single point just above the Tier 3 box, indicating that their independent outputs are brought together.

**Tier 3: Merged Ratings and Agreement (Bottom Center)**
*   **Component:** A single rounded rectangle, centrally placed at the bottom of the diagram.
    *   **Dimensions:** Approximately 500 units wide by 140 units high.
    *   **Fill:** Pure white.
    *   **Border:** A 2-pixel solid line in medium Grey (#B0BEC5).
    *   **Header Bar:** A solid Dark grey (#78909C) rectangle, 30 units high, fixed at the top internal edge of the box.
        *   **Text:** Centered within the header bar, "Rater Agreement Analysis".
        *   **Font:** 11px serif bold font, pure white text.
    *   **Body Content (inside the white box, below the header):** The content is divided into two distinct columns.
        *   **Left Column (Metrics):**
            *   "Barrier agreement (Fleiss' κ): **0.611**" (10px serif, dark charcoal #333333; the value "0.611" is 10px serif bold).
            *   "Feasibility agreement (Fleiss' κ): 0.537" (10px serif, dark charcoal #333333).
            *   "Interpretation: Moderate agreement" (9px serif italic, muted blue-grey #4B636E).
        *   **Right Column (Output):**
            *   "→ barrier_coding_merged_3rater.csv" (9px serif italic, muted blue-grey #4B636E).
            *   "→ stage2_agreement_metrics.json" (9px serif italic, muted blue-grey #4B636E).
            *   (One blank line space)
            *   "Disagreements proceed to arbitration →" (9px serif bold, bright Orange #FF7043).

**Bottom Annotation:**
*   Centered horizontally below the Tier 3 box, a single line of text provides additional context.
*   **Text:** "Each pair receives 3 independent judgments · Structured prompt includes taxonomy definitions and coding hierarchy · Response parsed via JSON schema".
*   **Font:** 9px serif, muted blue-grey text color (#4B636E).
